title: surface
body:
## surface

Extracts the outer boundary surface of any dataset as polygonal data: the exterior faces of volume cells plus any 2-D, line and vertex cells already present. Use it to turn a volume mesh into a surface for rendering, normals, featureEdges, decimate or surface export, or to see the whole boundary of a CFD domain (walls, inlets and outlets together). Cell arrays are copied from the adjacent cell to each face and point arrays are passed; nothing is interpolated.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Interior faces are removed, so use slice or clip to see inside. Composite data is surfaced block by block, so faces between blocks remain.
- Cell values on the surface are those of the adjacent volume cell, not boundary-condition values; for OpenFOAM patch values select the patch regions in foam instead.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, on point data derived from the wavelet; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `ExtractSurface`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "surface",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
